source_note: 《珍珠囊補遺藥性賦》 contains 諸藥相反例, 十八反歌 and 十九畏歌; every row cites that text.

shiba_fan.note: The classical name 十八反 counts the DRUGS named in the verse (19 surfaces in 3 groups), not the number of pairs. The verse yields 16 canonical pair relations. Two documented modern variants (白芍/赤芍 for 芍藥) are included and flagged in variant_of.
shiba_fan.verse_text: 本草明言十八反，半蔞貝蘞芨攻烏；藻戟遂芫俱戰草，諸參辛芍叛藜蘆。

shijiu_wei.note: 十九畏 names 19 drugs. The verse yields 9 canonical pair relations; the line 川烏草烏不順犀 names 犀角 and adds 2 genuine relations, giving 11. Nothing is padded.
shijiu_wei.verse_text: 硫黃原是火中精，朴硝一見便相爭。水銀莫與砒霜見，野狼毒最怕密佗僧。巴豆性烈最為上，偏與牽牛不順情。丁香莫與鬱金見，牙硝難合京三稜。川烏草烏不順犀，人參最怕五靈脂。官桂善能調冷氣，若逢石脂便相欺。

viruddha.note: Ayurvedic viruddha (incompatible) pairings are discussed in the Sanskrit corpus but a machine-readable classical *list* equivalent to the 十八反 verse was not located in an openly licensed source within the project window, so no rows are claimed. Recorded as a gap rather than invented.
